overview: Stylized water ribbon materials should read as a flowing translucent band with a controlled body, readable edge polish, and directional breakup that suggests motion without turning into forcefield glass.
common_failure_modes: opaque plastic strip instead of translucent water ribbon
static glassy read with no directional flow
full-surface emissive flooding overpowering the body
forcefield-like shell read replacing liquid motion
noisy crack patterning that fights the ribbon silhouette
capture_review_checklist: Front shot keeps a readable translucent body, not a solid strip.
Three-quarter shot suggests directional flow without becoming noisy.
Grazing shot strengthens edge polish while keeping the body readable.
The brightest accents stay controlled along the edge and do not flood the whole ribbon.

build_material_depth_mask_lane.goal: Establish a readable translucent ribbon body before directional breakup or edge polish is layered on.
must_read: body still visible from front view

build_material_bump_offset_uv_lane.goal: Introduce directional liquid breakup so the ribbon stops reading as static glass.

build_material_fresnel_lane.goal: Add restrained edge polish that supports the liquid silhouette instead of replacing it.

branch_restart_triggers: static glassy read with no directional flow
full-surface emissive flooding overpowering the body
